text:
sasha: Heads-up — trying to finalize rollout/rollback signals for staged flags. Need a quick consensus on the contract between runtime telemetry and the console dashboard before I write the spec. anyone?

jordan: Quick Q: do we want a simple boolean 'rollback' flag, or a structured list of reasons + metadata? :thinking_face:

lee: structured reasons. UI can map to badges. e.g. reason="increased_error_rate" or reason="latency_regression", plus a short metric snapshot like '95p>200ms'.

ops-bot: incident-bot: rule created: config-rollbacks alert when baseline 5m 500-rate > 0.5% and recent rollout_pct > 10% (auto action: notify #incidents).

anita: We should require a telemetry tag 'flag_snapshot_id' on all requests affected by the flag so we can replay traffic and attribute metrics to a specific rollout snapshot.

mike: Implementation detail proposal: runtime emits metric 'flag.rollback_signal' with labels: flag_id, reason, snapshot. Values are counts; dashboard reads these and correlates to errors/latency. ok?

jordan: Only ask: label cardinality. snapshot label must be short (hex digest <=8 chars) so metrics backend doesn't explode.

devex: Console needs an internal endpoint to fetch correlated telemetry + traces for a snapshot. Suggest GET /internal/flags/{flag_id}/snapshots/{snapshot_id}/telemetry?window=24h — returns aggregated metrics + a handful of request traces for quick inspection. Example curl: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ 
  "https://console.redwood.ai/internal/flags/beta_ui/snapshots/a1b2c3/telemetry?window=1h"
```

sasha: Sketch of the event payload we're proposing (simple, human readable):
```
event: rollback
flag_id: beta_ui
snapshot: a1b2c3
reason: increased_error_rate
metric: 500_rate
value: 1.2
window_s: 300
```

lee: LGTM. Also add optional field 'suggested_action' with enum {revert, reduce_traffic, patch} so ops/console can surface a one-click action.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: quick note — automation can accept suggested_action=revert and create a revert PR for the flag config. needs an allowlist.

sasha: Next steps: I'll draft a short spec with the payload + metric names + label cardinality rules. DevEx (devex) to mock the UI panel and the one-click action; Infra (mike) to add metric emitters with short snapshot ids; Ops to confirm allowlist flow. I'll ping owners in a doc later. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
